mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_feishu_org_schedule WHERE id = 1 AND deleted_at = 0
SELECT * FROM sys_feishu_org_schedule WHERE id = 1 AND deleted_at = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_feishu_org_schedule SET enabled = #{enabled}, interval_minutes = #{intervalMinutes}, daily_time = #{dailyTime}, missing_count_limit = #{missingCountLimit}, missing_percent_limit = #{missingPercentLimit}, verified_app_hash = #{verifiedAppHash}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = 1 AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_feishu_org_sync_log WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_feishu_org_sync_log SET status = 'FAILED', ended_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), error_message = '任务执行超时或服务中断，请重新预览后同步' WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND trigger_type != 'PREVIEW' AND deleted_at = 0 AND lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE sys_feishu_org_sync_log SET status = 'RUNNING', attempts = attempts + 1, lease_until = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE), error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND available_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND deleted_at = 0

UPDATE sys_feishu_org_sync_log SET status = 'PENDING', lease_until = NULL, available_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{delaySeconds}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)), error_message = '飞书连接暂时不可用，等待自动重试' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND deleted_at = 0
